Dave Matthews Band
August 28, 2021
Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach  
Virginia Beach, Virginia

Taper: Mark Terrell
Source: Schoeps MK4s > Naiant IPA > Tascam DR-05X
Location: Stage left by front pit rail, under the stack, 2ft from the rail, mics DIN @ 12'
Editing: WAV > Audacity 2.3.2 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

02. Tripping Billies
03. Funny The Way It Is
04. Grace Is Gone
05. Sweet Up And Down
06. So Much To Say >
07. Anyone Seen The Bridge >
08. Too Much
09. Walk Around The Moon
10. Grey Street
11. Can't Stop
12. Dancing Nancies >
13. Warehouse
14. Lover Lay Down
15. Rooftop
16. Don't Drink The Water
17. You & Me
18. Why I Am
19. Everyday >
20. Ants Marching
21. Encore Break
22. The Space Between
23. All Along The Watchtower
